propositions: Current clarity_score duplicated across gates.py and det_floor.py rewards volume and legacy shape rather than author-guide leaf/container contract, enabling padded tickets to pass without required sections.

Clarity measure lacks deterministic checks for required-section shape (nonempty Context/Problem and AC for all plans; Approach and Scope for leaves), placeholder-free executable scope, per-AC verification coverage, and testing shape when declared.
Author guide conflicts with G6 criteria on rejected-alternative requirement and with active epic on Success Criteria heading; current clarity does not detect or enforce these inconsistencies.

Seven candidate deterministic additions (section shape, AC verification coverage, placeholder lexicon, grounded edit-set, AC text hygiene, testing markers, and structural signals) can be mechanically detected without semantic judgment.
Clarity scoring should derive from named applicable checks with per-check evidence rather than aggregating length and bullet-point bonuses on the current seven-point scale.
